It started with a notebook in Hawaii Localbird didn't begin as a startup idea – it began on a family trip to Hawaii. Ben and Joseph, our founders were staying at a vacation rental when the usual Google searches stopped being helpful. They weren't looking for tourist traps; they wanted something real, the kind of experience only someone who lives there would know. So they asked their host. Instead of sending a link, he handed them a dusty, half-torn notebook filled with handwritten recommendations – real places, real people, local secrets that never make it online. And in that moment, it clicked. Hosts weren't just offering a place to sleep. They were holding a world of stories, insight, and connection – but had no easy way to share it. That simple realization became the seed of Localbird. We set out on a mission To help hosts grow, earn, and create experiences they are proud to share, and transform travel into something deeper than logistics, shaping stays that feel honest, effortless, and full of wonder. Meet our Team We come from different places, but we share one mission: make every stay unforgettable.
